settings.title: Architecture & 3D Visualization
settings.about: I am a professional architect and 3D visualization artist specializing in architectural renderings, interior design visualization, product design, and motion animations. With a passion for bringing architectural visions to life, I create stunning photorealistic renders that help clients visualize their projects before construction begins.

projects.title: USA   house Design
projects.description: A contemporary two-story American suburban residence designed with a focus on seamless indoor-outdoor living, spatial ergonomics, and modern aesthetic elegance. The architecture features expansive floor-to-ceiling glass windows that flood the interior with natural daylight, complemented by warm evening facade lighting, a spacious multi-level balcony, and an integrated outdoor poolside entertainment deck. The material palette blends clean white vertical paneling with rich timber accents, balancing modern minimalism with timeless residential comfort.
